description: A tag test on a reference reads the constituent's tags. t over the synthetic T has none, so t⊇T fails, and the check passes with the chosen reading alone. Compare reparse-terminal-tag-test (engine §7.5).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%elidable T U
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a A [T]
%rule b A [T] [U]
%rule c A t⊇T
%rule t T
